question: How does fasting by day lead to overcoming death from aging?
premises: Non-eating by day is prescribed as a means.
Death associated with age is named as the target.
A future overcoming of that death is asserted.
inference: Through fasting by day, one will overcome death caused by aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate may mean will go to or will overcome depending on idiom
plain_english: By fasting during the day, one will overcome death from aging.
